The vendor directly providing the software product at the domain **telex.automattic.ai** (originally launched as **Telex**, an AI WordPress block and code generator developed following Automattic's integration of CodeWP technology) is **Automattic Inc.**.

### Evidence & Provider Statement
* **Domain & Product:** `telex.automattic.ai` (Telex).
* **Automattic Terms of Service:**
  > *"We (the folks at Automattic)... These Terms govern your access to and use of the software, applications, extensions, and other products and services we provide through or for WordPress.com, WooCommcerce.com, WooPay, Jetpack.com, Gravatar.com, VaultPress.com, Happy.Tools, Jetpack CRM, MailPoet, WPScan.com, Studio, WordPress.com Courses, BlazePro.com, QuickForget.com, Beeper, and **Telex** (our 'Services')."*
* **Copyright Notice:** © Automattic Inc.
